title: EEG meditation study
description: This EEG dataset comprises recordings from 24 subjects during a meditation task with periodic interruptions to assess concentration and mind-wandering levels. Subjects were recorded using BIOSEMI equipment at 256 Hz (downsampled from original 2048 Hz acquisition). The dataset provides a resource for investigating neural correlates of meditative states and attentional processes.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using BIOSEMI equipment at 2048 Hz and subsequently downsampled to 256 Hz using the BDF decimator. During the meditation task, subjects were interrupted approximately every 2 minutes to report their level of concentration and mind-wandering.
